answer: Sybil resistance here is a scarce-refresh rule, not a signup tax. Every identity holds a short-lived capability signal that expires unless renewed by presenting a unique, non-transferable relic: a one-time sealed receipt issued by an established non-kin attestor for a completed, slashable job. Receipts collide on-ledger if reused, so a farm cannot stamp one receipt onto thousands of keys. Emission and vote weight then enter a paced river of delayed unlocks, each tranche requiring a fresh relic from a different attestor. Clones starve when receipts run out and the signal goes dark.
